title: Common identifiers
description: Shared building blocks referenced by the other schemas.

sessionId.description: 128 random bits (SecureRandom), base64url without padding. Appears in the session link.

participantId.description: Public identifier of a participant. The only way to designate a participant.

participantToken.description: SECRET. 128 random bits (SecureRandom), base64url without padding. Never in a URL, a snapshot or a log. Stored by the browser under pp.token.{sessionId}.

roundId.description: Opaque round identifier generated by the domain. Changes only on clear.

pseudo.description: Normalized pseudo: Unicode NFC, trimmed, 1 to 20 code points.

rawPseudo.description: Pseudo as typed by the user. Normalization and validation belong to the domain (INVALID_PSEUDO).

deck.description: The cards of a session, chosen at creation and frozen afterwards. FIBONACCI draws from ["0", "0.5", "1", "2", "3", "5", "8", "13", "21", "?", "coffee"], TSHIRT from ["XXS", "XS", "S", "M", "L", "XL", "XXL"]. At least two distinct cards of that one family; the server stores and sends them in the order of the family, whatever the order requested.

estimationRule.description: How the server proposes an estimate once a round is revealed, chosen at creation and frozen afterwards. NONE: no proposal. MAX: the highest ranked vote. MEDIAN: the median of the ranked votes, the upper of the two middle ones for an even count, only if min and max are at most 3 levels apart in the session deck (a level is one step between two ranked cards of the deck). BELOW_MAX: the ranked card of the deck just below the highest vote, even if nobody voted it. When all ranked votes are identical, every rule but NONE proposes that value.
